execution_path.description: Creates Mission object with initial state RECEIVED
Creates Run linked to Mission, sets as current run
Creates AgentTask with dependencies, adds to task_graph and task_runnable_cache
Validates DAG for cycles and missing dependencies
Returns tasks with all dependencies COMPLETED and state=READY
Selects agent by type (exact match first, then capability-based). Deterministic: highest max_tokens wins.
Creates agent instance, manages lifecycle (ASSIGNED->RUNNING->COMPLETED/FAILED), calls agent.execute()
Agent lifecycle: on_start() -> execute() -> on_complete() / on_failed(). Emits AGENT_STARTED/COMPLETED/FAILED events.
Validates image allowlist, resource limits, grants. Executes via Windows Job Objects or subprocess fallback. Captures stdout/stderr/artifacts.
Writes content to sandbox /artifacts dir, computes SHA256, returns Artifact with artifact_id, path, sha256, size
Creates EvidenceRecord linking artifact sha256 to mission/run/task. Stores in evidence store.
Mechanical verification of acceptance criteria (FILE_EXISTS, FILE_CONTAINS, FILE_HASH_MATCHES). Returns VerificationReport with verdict=evidenced/not_evidenced.
Updates task graph state, emits STATE_TRANSITION event with from_state, to_state, trigger
Emits FactoryEvent to event_bus for all lifecycle events: mission/run/task/agent/tool/verification/checkpoint
Captures full task graph state (task_states, task_definitions, dependencies, attempt_history, agent_assignments) and persists to disk as JSON
Loads checkpoint from disk, reconstructs task graph with same task_ids, states, dependencies, attempt_history. New run with parent_run_id.
Main loop: while runnable tasks exist -> select agent -> execute -> verify -> checkpoint. Returns results with final_status and task_results

key_integration_points: Task state -> Checkpoint -> Disk -> Resume -> Task graph reconstruction
known_gaps: LLM Gateway integration for Planner/Implementer agents (requires provider)
Full MissionStateMachine (13 states) not yet wired to ExecutionEngine
Grant validation not fully integrated in sandbox execution
